title: spec(view): FormViewSchema drawerSide / drawerWidth are accepted on a form view and read by no form-view surface; the describe says the question "stays open on #27153", which is closed
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix acceptance[2]: a key stored, served and silently inert).
Business reason: an author who writes `drawerSide: 'left', drawerWidth: '480px'` on a form view gets a valid save and publish (a bad enum is even refused 422), and the form still opens as the centred dialog or the page. ADR-0049 says such a key is either enforced or removed. The describe in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (about L5155) says the drawer half of that question "stays open on #27153", but #27153 closed on 2026-10-28 after retiring only `buttons.reset`, so no open card owns it.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:spec` lane: retire both keys on a form view (tombstone and conversion) or open the ui half to render a form view in a drawer. QA suggestion only: p3.
Duplicate search: `drawerSide` → 9 hits, all closed: #27153 (retired buttons.reset, left the drawer keys), #26843, #27155 (retired `type: 'drawer'`), #27159 (ObjectForm drops the drawer branch). `drawerWidth` → 15 hits, none open on this.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. On a writable package: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/qar8_fdr.form?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `{object:'qar8_fdr', viewKind:'form', isDefault:true, config:{type:'simple', sections:[…], drawerSide:'left', drawerWidth:'480px'}}`, then publish. The live read carries both keys.
2. Open the list → New, and `/_console/forms/qar8_fdr.form`.

Expected: a 480 px drawer from the left, or a refusal at save. Actual: the same centred dialog / in-page form as a control view without the keys; `drawerSide:'middle'` → 422, so the key is validated and never read. Reproduced 2 times.

## Mechanism
Only `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx` reads them, for a React `ObjectForm` block given `formType='drawer'`; no metadata form-view surface reaches it (the describe says so: "Inert on a form view since `type: 'drawer'` was retired").

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[2]
